findings.title: Starter ignore list misses common lockfiles
findings.detail:
The heading says lockfiles are ignored, but `**/*.lock` matches yarn.lock and bun.lock, not package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml or bun.lockb.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Add `**/package-lock.json` and `**/pnpm-lock.yaml`, or word the heading as examples.
